newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize down in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize down in cautious trade.

text.p: Argentine maize prices slipped in cautious cash trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange as local players decided to wait on the sidelines as Chicago fell, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for Buenos Aires maize lost $1 to $111. Soybean prices were unchanged, but volume was also sapped by the falls in Chicago. Buenos Aires crushers were paying $304 for beans. Cash sunflower seed rose in tight trade with little supply despite the harvest. Buenos Aires sunseed rose $3 to $215. Trade in wheat was slow, with export markets going through a slow patch. Bahia Blanca lost $2 to $147.
